cases.name: genesis-witnessed
cases.description: Genesis requires 2 of 3 witnesses and has them.

cases.name: genesis-under-threshold
cases.description: Genesis has 1 of the 2 required approvals.

cases.name: witness-file-missing
cases.description: Witnesses are required but no witness file was supplied.

cases.name: witness-file-malformed
cases.description: The witness file is a JSON object, not an array.

cases.name: duplicate-approvals
cases.description: Two proofs from the same witness count once.

cases.name: unlisted-witness
cases.description: A proof from a witness not in the list is ignored.

cases.name: proof-for-other-version
cases.description: A proof signed over a different versionId is filed under this one.

cases.name: later-proof-covers-earlier
cases.description: Only entry 3 has proofs; they approve entries 1 and 2 too.

cases.name: unpublished-proofs-ignored
cases.description: The witness file has proofs for a versionId not in the log.

cases.name: last-entry-unwitnessed
cases.description: Entries 1–2 are witnessed, entry 3 is not.

cases.name: enable-later-immediate
cases.description: Entry 2 turns witnessing on; the new list applies to entry 2 itself.

cases.name: enable-later-unwitnessed
cases.description: Entry 2 turns witnessing on but has no approval.

cases.name: replace-list
cases.description: Entry 2 replaces witness A with B. Entry 2 is witnessed by A; entry 3 by B.

cases.name: replace-list-new-witness-too-early
cases.description: Entry 2 is approved only by the incoming witness B.

cases.name: turn-off
cases.description: Entry 2 sets witness to {}; entry 2 still needs A, entry 3 needs nothing.

cases.name: turn-off-unwitnessed
cases.description: Entry 2 sets witness to {} but was not approved by A.

cases.name: witness-checked-after-entries
cases.description: Entry 2 is invalid (bad hash) and also unwitnessed; the entry error wins and entry 1 stays valid.
